figures.finding: The Netherlands Antilles no longer exist: on 10 October 2010 Curaçao and Sint Maarten became autonomous countries and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba became special municipalities of the Netherlands, so film work there follows those successors' rules, not the Antilles'.

sources.said: On 10 October 2010 Curaçao and St Maarten became autonomous countries. Bonaire, St Eustatius and Saba became special municipalities of the Netherlands.
